name: Vercel Blob Storage
shortDescription: Simple, durable blob storage integrated with Vercel projects and Edge Middleware.
description: Simple, durable blob/object storage tightly integrated with Vercel projects and Edge Middleware. Great for uploads, public/private files, and serving media with minimal configuration.
We use it for straightforward file storage in Vercel-hosted apps, leveraging built-in upload APIs, signed URLs, and region-aware performance.
useCases: Public/private file delivery with signed URLs
